card.name: Linking words in dose-adjustment advice
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, in) or a verb like interrupt or reduce that come right after adjust, modification, or dosage in drug-interaction advice. Also fires on 'steady' in 'steady state'.

modes.label: Word after adjust/modification
modes.description: A small word such as of or the that follows adjust, modification or adjustment, right before the thing being changed.
modes.example: consider a dosage modification<< of>> such substrates when initiating or discontinuing

modes.description: A dose-related word like dosage or interrupt in an instruction to change therapy during an interaction.
